text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Karlsruhe stood at 13.53 €/m², up 4.8 % year‑on‑year and 26.3 % over the past five years, placing the city 13th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 60 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing about 812 € per month.

The market remains balanced but tight: listings spend an average of 22 days on the market, only 30 % are let within a week, and the vacancy rate is 1.5 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 17.1 %, while population growth has been slightly negative (‑1.0 % over five years).

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 13.99 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 13.55 €/m² and 14.4 €/m², implying a modest 3.4 % increase.
